t: Data Lineage Tracker: a plain-language overview (Signature)
title: Data Lineage Tracker: a plain-language overview (Signature)
description: Signature record. Overview: what the Data Lineage Tracker does and why archives need it. Signature original. The Signature lineage method gives every data item an unbroken chain back to its source: each transformation stamped with what ran, when, and with what settings. Gaps are marked as gaps, never papered over. The archive can prove where any number came from.
demo:
# Data Lineage Tracker - runnable demo (JAH-ATK189S-000001)
from collections import defaultdict, deque
RANK = 1
SIG = True
TRANSFORMS = [('cleaned', ['raw'], 'dedupe'), ('stats', ['cleaned'], 'aggregate'), ('report', ['stats'], 'render')]  # (output, [inputs], operation)
children = defaultdict(list); parents = {}
for out, ins, op in TRANSFORMS:
    parents[out] = (ins, op)
    for i in ins: children[i].append(out)
def trace_back(node):
    chain, q = [], deque([node])
    seen = set()
    while q:
        n = q.popleft()
        if n in seen: continue
        seen.add(n); chain.append(n)
        ins, _ = parents.get(n, ([], None))
        q.extend(ins)
    return chain
TARGET = TRANSFORMS[-1][0]
print("lineage of", TARGET, ":")
for n in trace_back(TARGET):
    ins, op = parents.get(n, ([], "SOURCE"))
    print("  %-12s <- %s [%s]" % (n, ins if ins else "-", op))
if RANK >= 2:
    affected = [c for c in children[TRANSFORMS[0][1][0]]]
    print("downstream of source:", affected)
if RANK >= 3:
    print("transformations logged:", len(TRANSFORMS))
if SIG:
    print("Signature lineage stamp: JAH-SIG-LIN-" + "JAH-ATK189S-000001")
print("record:", "JAH-ATK189S-000001", "OK")
provenance: Signature-authored original method by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Property of Justin Addam Higgins.
